references.title: Batch Inverse-Variance Weighting: Deep Heteroscedastic Regression
references.use: Stabilized inverse-variance regression and batch weight normalization. Our slot-level target variance is an adaptation, not the paper's known label-noise variance.

references.title: On the Pitfalls of Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Estimation with Probabilistic Neural Networks
references.use: Variance-dependent regression objectives can have optimization pitfalls. Its learned-variance setting differs from our fixed train-only weights.

references.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
references.use: Microstructure motivation to inspect intraday volatility/depth heterogeneity; no evidence of gains for this A-share competition weighting.

risks: Per-time target variance is a proxy, not conditional label-noise variance; useful high-volatility signals may be downweighted.
Ten-day training estimates can drift; only two four-day validation windows are available.
Reweighting changes the objective despite normalization; weighted loss is not the evaluation metric.
Train_std already worsens second-window worst-day returns; report whether weighting repairs or worsens them.
Repeated research selection limits confidence; final interval stays frozen.

train_only_formula.constant_target: If v_all=0, all weights=1; log fallback.
train_only_formula.fit_scope: Original-unit labels selected by training split and fit_mask only; no validation/final labels. Freeze before optimizer updates.
train_only_formula.missing_slot: Fail if any configured training time is absent after fit_mask.
train_only_formula.normalization: w_t=a_t/(sum_u n_u*a_u/sum_u n_u); training sample-weighted mean weight=1
train_only_formula.provenance: Persist global/per-time variance, epsilon, weights and sample/day counts in logs/checkpoints; inference never uses weights.
train_only_formula.reporting: loss and validation loss stay unweighted in original return-squared units; weighted_loss and optimization_loss are separate.
